displayName: Tooling (production resources / tools: mould, die, cutting tool, fixture)
description: ISA-95 physical asset of the kind tooling (DE Fertigungshilfsmittel, SAP production resources/tools; owner D3): own identity, moves between machines and the store; abstract — a plant names a Mould, Die, CuttingTool or Fixture. The mounted tool is the segment's PhysicalAssetActual (audit H2).

properties.name: storage_location_ref
properties.description: The StorageLocation (AT_LOCATION; ISA-95 PhysicalAsset → OperationalLocation). Optional.

properties.name: physical_asset_class_ref
properties.description: The PhysicalAssetClass (DEFINED_BY; ISA-95 PhysicalAsset → PhysicalAssetClass). Optional.

properties.name: parent_tool_ref
properties.description: The Tooling this Tooling is part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 PhysicalAsset MADE_UP_OF PhysicalAsset). Optional.

properties.name: test_specification_ref
properties.description: The TestSpecification (TESTED_BY; ISA-95 PhysicalAsset → TestSpecification). Optional.

properties.name: spatial_definition
properties.description: The spatial definition (ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.2): the location or shape as text in spatial_format. Optional.

properties.name: spatial_format
properties.description: The format of spatial_definition (e.g. WKT). Optional.

properties.name: spatial_srid
properties.description: The spatial reference system of spatial_definition (SRID). Optional.

relationships.description: ISA-95 PhysicalAsset MADE_UP_OF PhysicalAsset: the tooling this tooling is part of. Optional.

isa95.note: ISA-95 PhysicalAsset (tooling, owner D3). The mounted tool of a machine is the segment's PhysicalAssetRequirement / PhysicalAssetActual, never Equipment IMPLEMENTED_BY (audit H2).
isa95.mappingNote: parent_tool_ref is the containment key (PART_OF PhysicalAssetChild, reverse). The kind of tooling is its profile (Mould, Die, CuttingTool, Fixture), no free-text type; the machine it is mounted on belongs to the segment actual (audit H2).
